verses.title: Evil Turned for Good
body: As for you, what you intended against me for evil, God intended for good, in order to accomplish a day like this—to preserve the lives of many people.

verses.title: Stay Calm
body: The LORD will fight for you; you need only to be still.”

verses.title: You're Never Abandoned
body: Be strong and courageous; do not be afraid or terrified of them, for it is the LORD your God who goes with you;
He will never leave you nor forsake you.”

verses.title: God Goes Ahead of You
body: The LORD Himself goes before you; He will be with you. He will never leave you nor forsake you.
Do not be afraid or discouraged.”

verses.title: Carried by God's Everlasting Arms
body: The eternal God is your dwelling place, and underneath are the everlasting arms.

verses.title: God is With You Wherever You Go
body: Have I not commanded you to be strong and courageous? Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”

verses.title: God, Your Rock and Refuge
body: My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation. My stronghold, my refuge, and my Savior, You save me from violence.

verses.title: Seek God's Strength
body: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.

verses.title: The Battle Belongs to God
body: This is what the LORD says: ‘Do not be afraid or discouraged because of this vast army, for the battle does not belong to you, but to God.

verses.title: The LORD's Joy Is Your Strength
body: Do not grieve, for the joy of the LORD is your strength.

verses.title: Your Redeemer Lives
body: But I know that my Redeemer lives, and in the end He will stand upon the earth.

verses.title: Refined by Trials
body: Yet He knows the way I have taken; when He has tested me, I will come forth as gold.

verses.title: The LORD Lifts Your Head High
body: But You, O LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the One who lifts my head.

verses.title: The LORD is a Refuge in Troubled Times
body: The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.

verses.title: You Will Not Be Shaken
body: I have setc the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

verses.title: The LORD is Your Shepherd
body: 1 The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want. He makes me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside quiet waters.

verses.title: Though You Walk Through the Darkest Valley
body: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.

verses.title: The LORD is Your Light and Salvation
body: The LORD is my light and my salvation—whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life—whom shall I dread?

verses.title: Wait Patiently for the LORD
body: Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous. Wait patiently for the LORD!

verses.title: The LORD is Your Strength and Shield
body: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart rejoices, and I give thanks to Him with my song.

verses.title: Joy Comes in the Morning
body: Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.

verses.title: Put Your Hope in the LORD
body: Be strong and courageous, all you who hope in the LORD.

verses.title: The LORD Delivers from All Fears
body: I sought the LORD, and He answered me; He delivered me from all my fears.

verses.title: The LORD Rescues from Trouble
body: The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears; He delivers them from all their troubles.

verses.title: The LORD is Close to the Brokenhearted
body: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.

verses.title: Commit Everything to the LORD
body: Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him, and He will do it.

verses.title: God Will Lift You Out of Despair
body: I waited patiently for the LORD; He inclined to me and heard my cry.
He lifted me up from the pit of despair, out of the miry clay; He set my feet upon a rock, and made my footsteps firm.

verses.title: Put Your Hope in God
body: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.

verses.title: God is Your Refuge and Strength
body: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.

verses.title: Be Still and Know That He is God
body: “Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted over the earth.”

verses.title: Give Your Burdens to the LORD
body: Cast your burden upon the LORD and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken.

verses.title: When You Are Afraid
body: When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.

verses.title: Every Tear is Recorded
body: You have taken account of my wanderings.Put my tears in Your bottle—are they not in Your book?

verses.title: Pour Out Your Heart to Him
body: Trust in Him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts before Him. God is our refuge.

verses.title: God Will Restore You to Life Again
body: Though You have shown me many troubles and misfortunes, You will revive me once again. Even from the depths of the earth You will bring me back up.

verses.title: God is the Strength of Your Heart
body: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

verses.title: The LORD is Your Refuge
body: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”

verses.title: God Will Rescue and Honor You
body: When he calls out to Me, I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him and honor him.

verses.title: The LORD Heals All Your Diseases
body: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and do not forget all His kind deeds—He who forgives all your iniquities and heals all your diseases,

verses.title: The LORD Is On Your Side
body: The LORD is on my side; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

verses.title: Be Strengthened by God's Word
body: My soul melts with sorrow; strengthen me according to Your word.

verses.title: The LORD's Promise Gives You Life
body: This is my comfort in affliction, that Your promise has given me life.

verses.title: Your Help Comes From the LORD
body: I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come? My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.

verses.title: The LORD heals The Brokenhearted
body: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.

verses.title: Trust in the LORD With All Your Heart
body: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways acknowledge Him, and He will make your paths straight.

verses.title: The Name of The LORD is a Strong Fortress
body: The name of the LORD is a strong tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.

verses.title: The Lord Will Keep You in Perfect Peace
body: You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.

verses.title: Those Who Trust in the LORD Will Find New Strength
body: But those who wait upon the LORD will renew their strength; they will mount up with wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not faint.

verses.title: Don’t be Discouraged
body: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My righteous right hand.

verses.title: His Mercies Begin Afresh Each Morning
body: Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail. They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!

verses.title: Blessed Are Those Who Mourn
body: Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted.

verses.title: Don’t Worry About Tomorrow
body: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Today has enough trouble of its own.

verses.title: Christ Will Give You Rest
body: Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

verses.title: Christ is With You Always
body: And surely I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”

verses.title: Just Believe
body: But Jesus overheard their conversation and said to Jairus, “Do not be afraid; just believe.”

verses.title: God's Word Will Never Fail
body: For no word from God will ever fail.”

verses.title: You Have Worth
body: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. So do not be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.

verses.title: Jesus is the Resurrection and the Life
body: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in Me will live, even though he dies.

verses.title: Don't Let Your Hearts be Troubled
body: “Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe in Me as well.

verses.title: Do Not Be Afraid
body: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.

verses.title: Take Heart
body: I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world!”

verses.title: God Will Fill You with Joy in His Presence
body: You have made known to me the paths of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence.’

verses.title: Endurance and Hope
body: Not only that, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.

verses.title: Future Glory Awaits
body: I consider that our present sufferings are not comparable to the glory that will be revealed in us.

verses.title: The Holy Spirit Helps Us in Our Weakness
body: In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weakness. For we do not know how we ought to pray, but the Spirit Himself intercedes for us with groans too deep for words.

verses.title: Everything Works Together for the Good
body: And we know that God works all things together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.

verses.title: God Is for Us
body: What then shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

verses.title: Nothing Can Separate Us from God's Love
body: For I am convinced that neither death nor life, neither angels nor principalities, neither the present nor the future, nor any powers, neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.title: Be Hoyful in Hope
body: Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, persistent in prayer.

verses.title: Wait Patiently for God's Promises
body: For everything that was written in the past was written for our instruction, so that through endurance and the encouragement of the Scriptures, we might have hope.

verses.title: Overflow with Confident Hope
body: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you believe in Him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.

verses.title: What God Has Prepared for Those Who Love Him
body: Rather, as it is written: “No eye has seen, no ear has heard, no heart has imagined, what God has prepared for those who love Him.”

verses.title: God is Faithful in Trials
body: No temptation has seized you except what is common to man. And God is faithful; He will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. But when you are tempted, He will also provide an escape, so that you can stand up under it.

verses.title: God Gives Us Victory Over Sin and Death
body: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ!

verses.title: He is the God of All Comfort
body: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort,

verses.title: You Are Never Abandoned by God
body: We are hard pressed on all sides, but not crushed; perplexed, but not in despair; persecuted, but not forsaken; struck down, but not destroyed.

verses.title: Fix Your Eyes on What is Unseen
body: So we fix our eyes not on what is seen, but on what is unseen. For what is seen is temporary, but what is unseen is eternal.

verses.title: God's Power Works Best in Weakness
body: But He said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.” Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest on me.

verses.title: Do Not Grow Weary
body: Let us not grow weary in well-doing, for in due time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.

verses.title: Empowered with Inner Strength by the Holy Spirit
body: I ask that out of the riches of His glory He may strengthen you with power through His Spirit in your inner being,

verses.title: God Can Accomplish Infinitely More
body: Now to Him who is able to do immeasurably more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us,

verses.title: God Will Finish What He Started
body: being confident of this, that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.

verses.title: Be Anxious for Nothing
body: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.

verses.title: Strength Through Christ
body: I can do all things through Christ who gives me strength.

verses.title: God Will Supply All Your Needs
body: And my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus.

verses.title: Let Christ's Peace Rule in Your Heart
body: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, for to this you were called as members of one body. And be thankful.

verses.title: Grieve with Hope
body: For since we believe that Jesus died and rose again, we also believe that God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep in Him.

verses.title: Christ Will Return
body: After that, we who are alive and remain will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will always be with the Lord.

verses.title: God's Eternal Comfort
body: Now may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself and God our Father, who by grace has loved us and given us eternal comfort and good hope, encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good word and deed.

verses.title: The Lord Will Strengthen and Guard You
body: But the Lord is faithful, and He will strengthen you and guard you from the evil one.

verses.title: God Has Not Given Us a Spirit of Fear
body: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

verses.title: Mercy and Grace in Times of Need
body: Let us then approach the throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.

verses.title: Hold Tightly to Hope
body: Let us hold resolutely to the hope we profess, for He who promised is faithful.

verses.title: Keep Your Eyes on Jesus
body: Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the authora and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy set before Him endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

verses.title: God Will Never Fail or Abandon You
body: Keep your lives free from the love of money and be content with what you have, for God has said: “Never will I leave you, never will I forsake you.”

verses.title: Endurance Grows Through Trials
body: Consider it pure joy, my brothers, when you encounter trials of many kinds, because you know that the testing of your faith develops perseverance.

verses.title: Healing Prayer Offered in Faith
body: Is any one of you sick? He should call the elders of the church to pray over him and anoint him with oil in the name of the Lord. And the prayer offered in faith will restore the one who is sick. The Lord will raise him up. If he has sinned, he will be forgiven.

verses.title: God Cares About You
body: Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.

verses.title: God Will Restore, Support, and Strengthen You
body: And after you have suffered for a little while, the God of all grace, who has called you to His eternal glory in Christ, will Himself restore you, secure you, strengthen you, and establish you.

verses.title: He Will Wipe Every Tear
body: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes,’ and there will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain, for the former things have passed away.”
